verdict.rationale: Evidence shows repo integrations (GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab) for source maps and internal error status management (Resolved/Ignored), but there is no mention of linking errors to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear tickets, nor any two-way status sync where resolving a ticket resolves the error or a regression reopens it. Missing for 10: any documentation of issue-tracker ticket linking, two-way status sync, or regression-triggered reopening.
